description: Per-event Binance-vs-bitFlyer price/flow snippets built around detected volatility bursts (radar-flagged "storm" windows and shorter "burst" spikes) for the storm-radar research line (src/bot/radar.py). One file per event, named by its detection timestamp.
source: extracted from the accumulated Binance BTCUSDT and bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY feeds around each radar-flagged event window -- see src/bot/radar.py and the scripts/build_* event-library tooling referenced in CLAUDE.md. data/burst_events/ and data/storm_events/ are the live, ungzipped working directories the backtest_data/*_events_<date>/ snapshots are periodically frozen from (same 'ts,bn_price,bf_price,bf_buy,bf_sell' header, verified).
retention: permanent dated snapshot (backtest_data/burst_events_<date>/, storm_events_<date>/); never regenerated in place. data/burst_events/ and data/storm_events/ are the ongoing working copy (kept indefinitely, appended forward, not itself dated) -- see known_defects.

ts.meaning: row time within the event window

bf_price.notes: blank when bitFlyer had no print/quote at this ts within the window -- a normal quiet moment on the thinner venue, not a collection failure

known_defects: data/burst_events/*.csv and data/storm_events/*.csv are plain (ungzipped) files, unlike their backtest_data/*_events_<date>/event_*.csv.gz snapshot counterparts -- same columns, different compression only
bn_price and bf_price are two different quote currencies (USD vs JPY) sampled from two different venues -- never diffed or ratioed directly without converting through a USD/JPY rate first

burst_events (shorter, sharper spikes) and storm_events (the storm-radar's own longer clock-window detections) are two different detectors over the same underlying feeds and are not deduplicated against each other -- the same underlying market move can appear as both a burst file and a storm file
bf_price/bf_buy/bf_sell blank/zero rows reflect bitFlyer's comparatively thin liquidity next to Binance, not a data-quality defect in the extraction itself
